notes: Read-only audit policy. Exact failsafe action must still be approved by the team before F9B; this baseline only rejects clearly disabled critical protections.

parameters.name: MAV_GCS_SYSID
parameters.purpose: FC must accept commands from the same GCS system id used by Core; supports current and legacy ArduPilot names

parameters.name: FS_GCS_ENABLE
parameters.purpose: Core/GCS disappearance must not be silently ignored by the FC

parameters.name: ARMING_SKIPCHK
parameters.purpose: Current ArduPilot: no global pre-arm check skip mask

parameters.name: ARMING_CHECK
parameters.purpose: Legacy ArduPilot: pre-arm safety checks must not be globally disabled

parameters.name: BATT_FS_CRT_ACT
parameters.purpose: Critical battery must have an onboard action independent of the cockpit

parameters.name: BATT_FS_LOW_ACT
parameters.purpose: Captured for team review; low-battery action may depend on field policy

parameters.name: FS_OPTIONS
parameters.purpose: Captured because option bits can change GCS/battery failsafe behavior

parameters.name: FENCE_ENABLE
parameters.purpose: Captured for comparison with Core geofence/radius policy

required_any.purpose: At least one supported ArduPilot pre-arm safety control must be present
